CustomField.description: Free-text notes on this item, replacing Task.Description. Long text is stored separately from the row, so selecting it costs more than the rest of the record combined - do not add it to a list-view selector or a bulk rollup query. WARNING for anyone writing tests against it: long text fields STRIP TRAILING WHITESPACE on save in this org, so a composed string does not survive a DML round trip byte for byte and an equality assertion on one will fail for a reason the message does not explain.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Notes about this item. Trailing blank lines are removed when the record is saved.
CustomField.label: Comment
